definition: to leave a building or home
sentence: I go out for a walk.

definition: to enter the place where someone is
sentence: Please come in and sit down.

definition: to return to a place
sentence: Come back before dinner.

definition: to return to the place where you live
sentence: We go home after school.

definition: to enter a bus, train or other large vehicle
sentence: Get on the bus here.

definition: to leave a bus, train or other large vehicle
sentence: Get off at the next stop.

definition: to enter a car or other enclosed space
sentence: Get into the car.

definition: to leave a car or other enclosed space
sentence: Get out of the car carefully.

definition: to change direction towards the left
sentence: Turn left at the corner.

definition: to change direction towards the right
sentence: Turn right at the traffic lights.

definition: to continue forward without turning
sentence: Go straight along this road.

definition: to move beyond a place or object
sentence: Go past the bank.

definition: to cross something on foot
sentence: Walk across the bridge.

definition: to move to a higher floor using stairs
sentence: Go upstairs to your bedroom.

definition: to move to a lower floor using stairs
sentence: Go downstairs for breakfast.

definition: to walk following the length of something
sentence: Walk along the river.

definition: to become unable to find your way
sentence: We get lost in the town.

definition: to ask someone how to reach a place
sentence: I ask for directions to the station.

definition: to leave one train and continue on another
sentence: We change trains at the next station.

definition: to register your arrival at a hotel or airport
sentence: We check in at the hotel.

definition: to leave a hotel after completing payment arrangements
sentence: We check out before eleven.

definition: to close the safety strap around your body in a vehicle
sentence: Fasten your seat belt before we drive.

definition: to arrange and usually pay for a ticket in advance
sentence: I book a ticket for tomorrow.
usage: book a ticket / a room / a table
additionalExamples: I booked a room for two nights.

definition: to travel in someone else's car as a passenger
sentence: I get a lift from my neighbour.

definition: to take someone somewhere in your car
sentence: Can you give me a lift to the station?

definition: to begin a journey
sentence: We set off early in the morning.

definition: to move a vehicle to the side of the road and stop
sentence: The driver pulls over beside the road.

definition: to put fuel into a vehicle until the tank is full
sentence: We fill up before the long journey.

definition: to stop working because of a fault
sentence: Our car breaks down on the way home.

definition: to become unable to move or continue
sentence: The car gets stuck in the mud.

definition: to travel past the stop where you intended to leave
sentence: I miss my stop and get off at the next one.

definition: to pass the checks before entering a secure area
sentence: We get through security at the airport.

definition: by walking rather than using a vehicle
sentence: We go to the park on foot.

definition: using a bus for travel
sentence: She goes to work by bus.

definition: using a car for travel
sentence: We travel to the town by car.

definition: during a journey towards a place
sentence: I see my friend on the way to school.

definition: away from normal work or study for rest or travel
sentence: They are on holiday by the sea.
